name: CI

on:
  pull_request: {}
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 6'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  msrv:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: musli_feature
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.85
    - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
    - run: cargo build -p musli --features test
    - run: cargo build -p musli-web --features test

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: musli_feature
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        test:
          - --all-targets
          - --doc
          - -p musli-core -p musli --doc --no-default-features
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
    - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
    - run: cargo test ${{matrix.test}} --features test

  loom:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: musli_feature
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
    - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
    - run: cargo test -p musli --release -- tests::loom
      env:
        RUSTFLAGS: --cfg loom

  tools_clippy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings
    needs: musli_feature
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      with:
        components: clippy
    - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
    - run: cargo run -p tools -- clippy

  tools_check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings
    needs: musli_feature
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
    - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
    - run: cargo run -p tools -- check

  no_std:
    runs-on: ${{matrix.os}}
    needs: musli_feature
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: ['windows-latest', 'ubuntu-latest']
        example: ['json', 'serde']
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - run: cargo +nightly run -p no-std --example ${{matrix.example}}

  nightly:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings --cfg musli_nightly
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      with:
        components: miri
    - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
    - run: cargo build --all-features
    - run: cargo build --tests --all-features

  fuzz:
    needs: [msrv, test, loom, tools_clippy, tools_check, musli_feature, recursive]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
    - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
    - run: cargo run --release -p tests --features test
    - run: cargo run --release -p tests --features test -- --random
    - run: cargo run --release -p tests --features test -- --all --iter 3

  miri:
    needs: [msrv, test, tools_clippy, tools_check, musli_feature, recursive]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
      with:
        components: miri
    - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
    - run: cargo miri test --features test
    - run: cargo miri run -p tests --features test
    - run: cargo miri run -p tests --features test -- --random

  no_default_features:
    needs: [rustfmt, clippy]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings
    steps:
